# Security Policy

## Supported versions

The repository has not published a versioned release. Until then, report issues against the current `__DEFAULT_BRANCH__` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](__SECURITY_ADVISORIES_URL__). Do not open a public issue for an unpatched vulnerability.

Include the affected commit, impact, and reproduction steps. The maintainers will acknowledge and coordinate reports as promptly as possible; please allow time to investigate and prepare a fix before public disclosure.
